In this episode of "Sammy Quest's Jurassic Adventure," The Assistant helps Sammy as she finds herself unexpectedly transported back to the Jurassic period after activating a mysterious feature on her smartphone. With the task of documenting five unique dinosaurs to return home, she embarks on an exciting journey filled with educational moments. Sammy encounters a Tyrannosaurus Rex, a baby Stegosaurus, a Triceratops, a Velociraptor, and a Pteranodon, sharing fascinating facts about each dinosaur along the way. As she captures photos and dances in celebration of her discoveries, she emphasizes the connection between dinosaurs and modern birds, highlighting their evolutionary lineage. Ultimately, Sammy completes her mission and is presented with the option for another adventure, leaving viewers eager for more.

tcFmExg-G9o.description:
Join The Assistant from TheEngineeringFamily as she goes on an exciting swamp adventure at Avery Island's famous Jungle Gardens! In this video, The Assistant is on a mission to find her favorite Paw Patrol pups—Rubble, Skye, and Chase—who are hiding throughout the beautiful Louisiana landscape.

Along the way, we get up close (but not too close!) with wild alligators, learn why Spanish moss isn't actually moss, and visit a massive Egret rookery. You'll even hear the amazing story of how one man helped save these beautiful birds from extinction. It’s the perfect mix of a Paw Patrol scavenger hunt and a nature field trip!

In this episode of "Paw Patrol Swamp Adventure," The Assistant and Mr Engineer explore the swamps of Louisiana in search of the Paw Patrol team. The adventure begins at the Jungle Gardens, where they encounter various wildlife, including alligators and baby turtles. As they navigate through the bayous, they successfully spot members of Paw Patrol, including Zuma, Skye, Tracker, and Chase, while learning about the local ecosystem and the significance of Spanish moss and live oak trees. The duo also discusses the behavior of alligators and the importance of preserving wildlife, culminating in the discovery of Mayor Humdinger perched in a giant tree. Despite their search for bears, they conclude their adventure without spotting any, encouraging viewers to like and subscribe to their channel.

Water is life!

We are joining over 1000 YouTube creators in an effort to raise $40 million for clean drinking water!

Don't worry, though; this game is not scary, and the "Natural disasters" are clearly not real - it is just a fun simulation for the entire family to play!

The Assistant had her Roblox and Adopt Me accounts hacked! Not only did the hacker steal all of her Adopt Me pets, but he also changed the account email and password and locked her out of her account! 

In this video, we describe the steps we took and how we were able to report the hack, and eventually reclaim her account.

One note- this video is mainly for parents... it may not seem like much, but your kid's Roblox account is (likely) to be a very significant thing to them, and it is very UNLIKELY they will be able to regain control of their account without your help. Regardless, this is a great opportunity to tell them the dangers of phishing and other online scams.

_NgMLbUfy_A.description:
This is an ad for Little Friends: Puppy Island. Check out this link to find out more:
https://url.superawesome.com/httpslittlefriendspuppyislandcomengineeringfamily


Join TheEngineeringFamily and their adorable pups, Wiggles and Waggles, as they dive into the world of Little Friends Puppy Island, the newest game for Nintendo Switch! In this fun and educational video, you'll get a chance to learn about puppy care, puppy breeds, outfits, and walking areas while watching the Assistant and her dogs play the game.

Follow along as they explore the different breeds of puppies available in the game, discussing the unique traits and characteristics of each breed. They'll also talk about the importance of puppy care, including feeding, grooming, and exercise, and share tips on how to keep your furry friend healthy and happy.

As they play, the Assistant and her pups will show you how to dress up your puppies in cute outfits and take them for a walk in the game's various areas. They'll also talk about the different types of terrain and environments you can expect to encounter in the game, from sandy beaches to lush forests.

Whether you're a dog lover or just looking for a fun and informative video to watch, "Playing Little Friends Puppy Island with The Assistant and her Dogs!"  is sure to be a hit. So grab your Nintendo Switch and join us on this exciting adventure!

Episode 1  -  The Adventures of The Assistant and Wiggles: Howie the Hamster and the Museum.

Howie the Hamster is never one to be happy in losing traps all of the kids from the field trip inside the museum. Will the Assistant save the day... and will Wiggles be able to but a dinosaur bone from the gift shop?

In the second video - What is wrong with the radio tower?

Sheila the Snake has taken over the local radio stations. She is using it to take over all of the neighborhood animals to take their owner's jewelry.  Can the Assistant and Wiggle use science to solve the problem and free the city from these radio waves?

This animated series has been produced by TheEngineeringFamily and Whipper Snapper TV!  
Executive Producer - Chris Yates
Executive Producer -James Tooley
Executive Producer  - Mr. Engineer

 The Assistant and Mr. Engineer used their actual voices for this episode.  Wiggles.... not-so-much.


Remember, each episode has a unique science experiment performed by the Assistant and Mr Engineer! So make sure to watch until the end

EPnOmIMfTE8.description:
This is a paid advertisement for the Ozobot Evo.

The Ozobot Evo is a fun and educational robot. He is small enough to fit into your pocket.  It really is an amazing product - it is super fun to play at a basic level, but it also allows kids (and us adults too) how to sequence code. However, it is not required - you can simply have fun driving your Ozobot Evo around without any need to code.... but... the Ozobot Evo helps make coding even more fun. Another great option feature is that you can draw mazes and races for your Ozobot to compete. It really is fun - the Assistant and I played with our Ozobot for 4 hours straight!

Honestly, despite this video being 14 minutes long we barely scratched the surface of all the cool things that we can do!

Have an Ozobot Evo? Look for "TEF Video" and "Assistant" to join us as friends (provided that you are over 13).


Learn more here http://ozobot.com/products/ozobot-evo

Toy Hackers is a show about toys who build toys. It’s kind of like if “toy unboxing” met “DIY how-to-build” videos. It’s a fun way for kids to learn how to invent creative stuff. 

Every week, we go on adventures and learn how to build real inventions that solve kids’ problems (like a DIY boombox, Mailbox alarm, Bucket Pinata, Art Bot, or Magic Carpet!) Follow along with Simone Giertz, the queen of not-so-good robots, for step-by-step how-to build videos so you can learn how to make all the inventions at home. 

Each episode is hosted by a different member of the Toy Hackers Secret Society, including the amazing:
• TheEngineeringFamily (https://www.youtube.com/user/TheEngineeringFamily) 
• Bratayley, elleoNyah (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXv4jJtbY_3w9Ppd_WYn1yA) 
• MyFroggyStuff (https://www.youtube.com/user/MyFroggyStuff) 
• BabyTeeth4 (https://www.youtube.com/user/babyteeth4) 
• JillianTubeHD (https://www.youtube.com/user/JillianTubeHD) 

See what happens as the Hackers (Goldie Blox, Ruby Rails, Valentina Voltz, and Li Gravity) use creativity, inventiveness, and everyday household objects to engineer their way through weekly missions. And you can Hack along.

Created by GoldieBlox
Executive Producers: Debra Sterling, Beau Lewis, Jenna Boyd
Director: Steve Flavin 

GoldieBlox is the award-winning children’s multimedia company disrupting the pink aisle in toy stores globally and challenging gender stereotypes with the world’s first girl engineer character. Through the integration of storytelling and STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) principles, GoldieBlox creates toys, books, apps, videos, animation and merchandise; the tools that empower girls to build their confidence, dreams and ultimately, their futures.

Watch the Assistant play Peanuts: Snoopy Town Tales on our iPad. We enjoyed exploring and meeting all of our Peanuts friends! 

Join Snoopy, Charlie Brown and the rest of the Peanuts gang as they build and explore their beloved town.  Snoopy is struggling to write his next great novel when he notices that a “new kid,” the Little Red-Haired Girl, has moved in next door. Snoopy decides to put his role of “World Famous Author” aside and instead adopt a new roll,  “Chair-Beagle of the Welcoming Committee.” Snoopy will write about the neighborhood and introduce this new kid to all his favorite people and places. •        Interact with Your Favorite Characters: Assemble all of your favorite Peanuts characters throughout gameplay including Charlie Brown, Lucy, Linus, Schroeder, Peppermint Patty and many more!

What better way to learn than with the Osmo! The Osmo educational system for your iPad, iPad Air, and iPad mini is a great way to blend technological fun with learning! This is a paid promotion for the Osmo system.

Interested in learning more - check out their website!https://www.playosmo.com/?r=470031765..

Osmo has four modes of play

Masterpiece - which allows you to transform any shape, toy, object into an object that you can draw! Perhaps you would prefer to trace one of Osmo's many preloaded pictures - it has everything from Jaguars to a map of the USA!

Word - While sight words can be overly dull the OsmoWords app allows you to play games while learning many of the traditional sight words (and beyond).

Newton - We love playing Newton - in some ways it is like incorporating your etch-a-sketch with a game of billiards with.... the game pong! Even better is that you can use your iPad's built in camera to add your favorite toys and shapes into the games!

Tangram - Finally we have Tangram - this is the Assistant's favorite game. Tangram challenges the user to make/copy rather complex puzzles while only using a series of wooden shapes. This is the game that keeps The Assistant up past her bedtime!

We love Minnie Mouse and Disney's Mickey Mouse Clubhouse! See all of our Surprise videos   http://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=... Please Subscribe Here http://www.youtube.com/user/TheEngine...

This video compares the Disney Junior Minnie Mouse and Figaro travel case toys.  Both are very cute cases for animated characters on the go! In fact, you may want to own both of the travel cases!

The Figaro travel case comes with a medium sized Figaro doll, a water bowl, a passport for Figaro, and two small travel bottles. However best of all it comes with a rolling carrier for Figaro!

The Disney Junior Mickey Mouse Clubhouse Minnie Mouse Travel Kit is a playset for anyone who wants to an all-in-one travel kit.  In some ways it reminds us of the Doc McStuffins check-up kit, but instead of doctor instruments it contains the things you need for (pretned travel).

Notes-

- Comes a plastic camera, a travel mirror, , and a twisty lip stick.

- A pretend passport, stickers, and credit card are included.

- All of the accessories can fit back into the bow shaped travel purse.


Final Verdict -  While we like the Minnie Mouse Travel Kit we would prefer that it contained a few more accessories. It would also be nice if the camera was at least have some lights or sounds.

3 1/2 Stars

We love Julius Jr on Nickelodeon! See all of our Surprise videos   http://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=... Please Subscribe Here http://www.youtube.com/user/TheEngine...

Nickeoldeon Julius Jr Rock 'n Playhouse is a fun playset for any fans of Julius Jr. While the music can be a little annoying for parents, but the playset as a whole is very popular with our daughter!

Notes-

- Comes with Julius JR figure. The Julius Jr. can bend at the waist, but surprisingly, the figure could not move its head or arms.

- The playhouse a dance floor, and when pressed it lights up and plays the theme music from the show.

- Has a cool elevator that plays sounds whenever it goes to a new floor.

- The twisty slide works well, but Julius Jr. is a bit large to fit through the secret passage that leads to the slide.

- One side of the playhouse is a rocket and an alien planet. It even comes with a small green alien.

- A keyboard and microphone are provided for Julius Jr 

- Comes with a skateboard - and it is a bit of a mystery - but the wheels on the skateboard are not real wheels.

Final verdict - The Julius Jr Rock 'n Playhouse can be a be a bit annoying for parents but it has lots of activities that will bring smiles to the faces of all young children.

4 Stars

With Mr. Engineer as an experienced engineer with a love of exploring new things, Mrs. Engineer an award winning teacher with a math and counseling focus, and their daughter The Assistant you can think of The Engineering channel as your imagination station. You can think of The Engineering Family channel as a Funbrain meets YouTube. This family is taking some of the coolest toys like Paw Patrol, Kinder Surprise Eggs, Scooby Doo, and Disney Princess to create hilarious videos the entire family can enjoy.

SoplTht70KM.description:
We love Despicable Me 2 with Minions! 

The board game Operation is one of the classics games. This is a review of the Despicable Me 2 Operation board game. You must remove all of the items out of the minion without causing the alarm to sound.

Notes-

- The game rules are very easy - players alternate trying to remove boo-boos from the board. You must use the metal surgical tweezers to remove the items without touching the metal sides. If you accidentally touch the sides a buzzer sounds and the nose lights up!

- Requires 2 batteries that are not included

- The Despicable Me 2 game  is  little easier than the original Operation game. The spaces are a little larger making it easier for younger children.

- The board is made of cardboard - so you do worry a bit about durability.


5 Stars

Disney Junior "Sofia the First" has become a huge hit for young girls (and some boys too). This video feature Sofia the First Bedtime Princess.

This Sofia the First doll speaks 10 phrases and it has eyes that open and close! The Sofia the doll is perfect for a bedtime buddy for any fan of Disney Junior Sofia the First.

We hope that Queen Elsa from the Disney movie Frozen will soon make an appearance on Sofia the First. Queen Elsa has become our four year daughter's favorite disney princess.

This video features Disney Junior Sofia the First. Sofia the First is about a young girl who becomes a princess when her mother marries the king. Our daughter loves some other Disney Junior shows, such Doc McStuffins. Doc McStuffins is a doctor for toys and can make them all better. Other favorites include Jake and the Neverland Pirates, Ella the Elephant, Henry Hugglemonster, The Octonauts, Mickey Mouse Clubhouse (although really - who is not a fan of Mickey Mouse Clubhouse), Sheriff Hallie.

In addition to Disney Junior she also loves to watch Nickelodeon and Nick Jr. Nickelodeon features many of our daughter's favorite shows including Paw Patrol which shows a band of problem solving Paw Patrol puppies! Other shows that she enjoys on Nickelodeon include Peter Rabbit, Backyardigans, and Olivia. She also loves watching Peppa Pig - which appears on Nickelodeon and on BBC Channel 5. Peppa Pig and her brother George - not to mention Mommy Pig and Daddy Pig.On PBS she enjoys watching Curious George and Sesame Street.

However, her favorite things to watch involve the Disney Princesses - she especially loves the Disney Movie Frozen and Queen Elsa when she sings "Let it Go" . Her other favorite movies are "A Princess Bride" , "Enchanted" , "Beauty and the Beast", Princess in "Tangled" , and Ariel in "The Little Mermaid".

About The Engineering Family
We are The Engineering Family, a family of educators working to show you how to make learning fun and engaging through toy unboxings, toy reviews, and original series designed to insight imaginative play within your family. The Fisher-Price Laugh and Learn Puppy's Activity Home is a medium sized infant and toddler toy. We have reviewed quite a few toys over the last few years and this one may be the best. It is simple enough for an infant to operate, but it has enough features that it kept our 4 year old entertained!

Notes-

- Has three modes - Learning mode (for the ABC's), Music Mode, and quiet mode.

- The top of the house opens and closes - which is fun for the child but it also allows for easy storage

- Comes with a puppy and a frog - and both act as rattle

- The home has lots of doors and switches that either light up or play sounds (and some do both).

- The door opens and closes and makes sounds

- Very tactile - different letters and shapes that can be touched and felt.

Negatives are pretty minimal -

- It does not have a volume control

- There is a chance that fingers could get pinched but it is pretty minimal

Final Verdict - The Fisher Price Laugh and Learn Puppy Activity Home is one of the best infant toys that we have reviewed. It provides fun music, shapes, and doors for that open or close.

5 Stars

This product was provided for an unbiased review

The Octonauts appear on both Disney Junior in the USA and the BBC in the UK. While it may not be quite as popular as some of the other Disney Junior shows such as Jake and the Never Land Pirates, Mickey Mouse Clubhouse, Doc Mcstuffins, or Sofia the First - it has quickly become popular with our four year old daughter.

This video features the Disney Junior Octonauts Gup F Build a Gup Vehicle  The Gup 

Notes is cool because you can design it any way that you want. 
The Gup F comes with claws. legs, cameras, and all of sorts of cool attachments.

- Does not come with any Disney Junior Octonauts figures

- The Gup F cannot be used in water

- The directions show you how to make 12 different Gup Vehicles!

- In many ways it is part Octonaut toy and part Legos! There are so many combinations for different vehicles that it really is fun

- Easy enough for children ages 3 up, but there are some small pieces so you will want to keep it away from children under 3.

Final Verdict - The Gup F allows you to create and design countless Gup Vehicles. While it would be nice if it could be used in the tub it is still a fun Disney Junior Octonaut Toy.

4 1/2 Stars

The board game Operation is one of the classics games. This is a review of the Disney Junior Doc McStuffins Operation game. A steady hand means that Doc can pull out the boo-boos without causing the alarm to sound.

Once you remove the boo-boo you must place a band-aid over the spot. 

Notes-

- The game rules are very easy - players alternate trying to remove boo-boos from the board. You must use the metal surgical tweezers to remove the items without touching the metal sides. If you accidentally touch the sides a buzzer sounds and the nose lights up!

- Requires 2 batteries that are not included

- The Doc McStuffins game  is  little easier than the original Operation game. The spaces are a little larger making it easier for younger children.

- The board is made of cardboard - so you do worry a bit about durability.


Final Verdict - A great new twist on an old game. Sure to be a hit with any fan of the game of the operation and Doc McStuffins

5 Stars

Jake and the Neverland Pirates is one of the most popular shows on the Disney Channel. 

In this video we show how you can use your Jake and the Never Land Pirate toys to create a candy adventure.

This Video uses both standard and Lego Duplo Disney Lego Duplo playsets.


 The Disney Lego Duplo Jake and the Neverland Pirates sets are a fun way to creatively act out and pretend to be a part of jake and his crew. The two sets that I am reviewing/comparing are Jake's Ship Bucky and the Neverland Hideout.

Jake's Ship Bucky - Comes with Jake, Captain Hook, Bucky and a block that has a picture of Skully. Kids of all skill levels will be able to assemble Bucky, but Pirate Island may be a bit more challenging. Another fun feature is that Bucky's water cannon actually fires. 

Neverland Hideout - Comes with Izzy and Cubby. There are lots of options for creating different types of Neverland Hideout. However, the picture on the box will challenge any child under four years old. A fun feature of the Neverland Hideout is the there are two pieces that rotate. This will allow you to create rotating bridge, trees, or even rotate Cuuby and Izzy!

The  Mickey Mouse Clubhouse Doctor Kit is a way for your Mickey Mouse Fan into a doctor. There are similar Disney Junior Doc McStuffins Doctor kits, but this one is designed for a Mickey Mouse fan.

Notes-

- Comes with a battery operated stethoscope. The stethoscope is probably the highlight of the set.

- Has a thermometer for checking temperature - each time you click the thermometer you change the temperature on its display.

- A small flashlight is included for checking throats and ears

- The blood pressure cuff doesn't pump with air.... unlike the one that comes with the Doc mcStuffins playset

- Has a small mirror

- A few other items are included like two band aids

Final Verdict - Our daughter prefers the Mickey Mouse Clubhouse Doctor kit over-and-above the one from Doc McStuffins. She prefers the blood pressure cuff from Doc McStuffins but she likes all of the additional doctor tools in the Mickey kit.

4 1/2 Stars

This video compares several of the Octonauts vehicles - note there are more that are not featured in this video (and if this video proves popular I may review them too!).

The Gup A Mission vehicle with Barnacles - is the largest of the Gup vehicles that I am reviewing. It can hold a couple of Octonauts and it features a propeller that can wind up and propel itself forward. Oddly the propeller works better on land than sea!

The Gup B with Kwazaii - Shaped like a shark! The Gup Be can gulp water and shoot it back out of the shark's mouth!

The Gup C with Shellington - Shaped like a Whale - the Gup C is probably my daughter's least favorite. Although she does like the scope that allows her to see to the bottom of the bath tub.

The Gup D with Barnacles - Probably the coolest of the Gup vehicles that we have reviewed. You can hook up the air hose to Barnacles and send him to the bottom of the bath tub. The Gup D also features a rescue net that shoots from the front to help rescue sea creatures.

My daughter's favorite is the Gup D with Barnacles- it is the one that continues to hold her interest
See all of our Octonauts Review

The Octonauts is a popular children's show on both Disney Junior and on the BBC.  As parents we really like the educational and conservation aspects of the show. The Octonauts search the ocean for various forms of sea life (the Gup A comes with an Angler Fish). The Octonauts also focus on how to protect ocean life and other aspects of conservation.

Notes-

- The Gup A comes with Barnacles

- Both a net and claw can be attached to the front of the Gup A for retrieving sea animals

- Has a twist propellor that can help propel the Gup A on the ground and on the tub - although it works (ironically) better on the dry ground than in the tub.

- Both the front and the back of the Gup A open up - it can easily store two or more Octonauts and all of their gear

Final Verdict - The Gup A Mission Vehicle is the largest of the Octonauts sets - it can easily hold two (or more Octonauts). While the Gup A has a propellor that turns it works much better on dry ground than in the tub.

4 Stars

ChuckE Cheese is the delight of all kids - and something that is generally tolerated by parents. ChuckE is mainly known for his birthday parties, but the Play Doh ChuckE Cheese Pizza Play Set lets them make their own pizzas... but the other games are not included!

Notes-

- Comes with a very real looking ChuckE - although we have had a lot of trouble keeping the ears of the mouse!

- Comes with a cheese grader and a pizza cutter/server

- ChuckE Cheese's nose can be used as a cheese press

- ChuckE's head and ears can be used for making the toppings - peppers, mushrooms, anchovies, and other toppings.

- Clean up is pretty simple - there are a limited number of places for the Play Doh to get trapped n.

Final Verdict- All kids love Chucke Cheese, but they may find that the ChuckE Cheese Pizza Play Set isn't quite as exciting. The high point of the play set is making the cheese come out of ChuckE's nose.

We love Baby Alive Real Surprises Baby! See all of our Surprise videos   http://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLoLQ9unpi4OEEM3rUVjLGa0pUaXQvW3Wd

Please Subscribe Here http://www.youtube.com/user/TheEngineeringFamily?sub_confirmation=1

It is a bit ironic, but almost as soon as your baby is out of diapers - they want a doll that requires the changing of diapers. The Baby Alive Real Surprises is a baby that talks, eats, drinks, sleeps, and uses a diaper just like a real baby.

Our daughter really likes the Baby Alive, but my wife and I think that it is a little too real - including the costs for baby food and diapers. 

Notes

- Baby Alive Surprise eats, drinks.... and has all of the body functions of a real baby.Children may like it, but parents will not like having to buy additional amounts of food and diapers (also just like a real baby).

- Baby alive talks... she tells you when she is hungry, full, tired, and when she has to go potty.

- The baby eyes open wen she is upright and closes when she lies down.

- Comes with bottle, bib, a food bowl and spoon, a pacifier, and three diapers and packets of foods.

- Very real and authentic looking baby - our daughter really liked the *realness*

- It is difficult to feed the baby without spilling the food down her chin - i guess it is like a real baby, but it does make a bit of a mess.

Final Verdict - The Baby Alive Real Surprises Doll acts and sounds like a real baby. Children will love the authenticity, but parents will dislike having to continuously having to buy pretend baby food and diapers.

4 1/2 Stars

hngONhmRzfs.description:
The Sofia the First Royal Prep Talking Desk looks like something that would be in the show, but we wish it was better designed and built. There are three main flaws to the desk, and while children may not mind they will definitely make parents cringe.

Notes-

- One of the flaws is that the top of the desk has a faux wood appearance (despite being purple). The issue is that the top of the desk has a wood texture and is not smooth. This makes it very difficult to write or color without getting your pencil/crayon stuck in the grooves.

- Another flaw is that desk is too small. Our four year daughter (who is tall for her age) is too tall to sit on the stool and fit into the desk.

- The final flaw is that the desk is made completely of plastic and is quite flimsy - if it is not against a wall it may want to tip over.

- Now the good news - the desk is very fun and features a built in chalk board.

- A compartment flips up on the desk to reveal a storage space for supplies

- A *locker* with a shelf is included

- Assembly takes about 20 minutes and is not very difficult - but be warned, once it is put together it is nearly impossible to disassemble.

Final verdict - The Sofia the First Royal Prep Desk may be fun for younger children, but kids over the age of three may be too old/big to use it.

Please Subscribe Here http://www.youtube.com/user/TheEngineeringFamily?sub_confirmation=1

Chuggington is a fictional town where  young trains - Brewster, Wilson, Hoot and Toot, Koko, and Piper learn the ways of the railroad and friendship. The set let's your child recreate the Frostini's Meltdown where Brewster has to help deliver ice to the ice cream factory. Chuggington is broadcast over Disney Junior in the USA and BBC in the UK. 

While Thomas the Train is more popular - Chuggington is still a very popular show for boys.... and some girls.

Notes

- The track only fits together one way - and it doesn't well together, so it takes 10 minutes to put together (if you read the directions) or 1 hour if you don't read the instructions.

- Comes with Brewster - a car, and a rail car saw - each car has a magnet on the front and back to connect.

- Has a crane for loading for loading unloading the blocks of ice onto Brewster.

- The tunnel on top of the bridge can be removed and can be placed anywhere on the track.

- Again, the biggest negative is the fit of the tracks - in some place they fit very loosely but in other areas they pinch and must be forced to lock together.

- Brewster and the rail cars do not roll smoothly over all of the tracks - and will likely jump off of the tracks when going down the hill.

Final Verdict - The Chuggington Wooden Railway is a nice,but expensive, wooden railway.  I wish the the track would fit together better so that Brewster and the cars could roll along the track a little more consistently. However, the time and effort still brings smiles from the kids.

4 Stars

One of the issues with some of the newer tv's and projectors is that do not have capability to use some of the older inputs (like composite cables or s-video). Some only have HDMI inputs - so the Sabrent S-Video/Composite to HDMI converter and scaler allows you to use your older dvd players, dvrs, Wii's , or other devices with your new televisions and projectors.

Notes

- Will accept standard composite inputs (which is the left & right audio and the yellow video cables) or a S-video and converts and upscales it to either a 720P or1080P signal through an HDMI output.

- Works very well - you can see in the video that there is a difference between the standard 480P image and the HD images. While it can't actually make a 480P to a true 1080P image quality - it can scale it correctly and improve the image quality.

- Does not come with cables (other than the power cable)

- The front of the converter has two buttons - one selects the input source (either composite or S-Video) the other one is to select between 720p and 1080p

Final Verdict - With the exception of the bright blue light I really don't see any flaws with the Sabrent S-Video and Composite to HDMI converter and scaler. It is easy enough for your parents to use, but still provides all of the capability you need to connect older audio video equipment to your new television or projector. Recommended

Each Year Fisher Price comes out with a New dancing/Musical Mickey Mouse just n time for Christmas. This year Fisher Price changed up the pattern a bit and introduced the Cheerin' Minnie Mouse. Minnie Mouse has a variety of cheerleading moves and, of course, plays the 1980's hit "Hey Mickey"

Notes-

- Minnie Mouse has several different cheerleading moves - but only plays one song, "Hey Mickey" - fortunately for all of us - Minnie plays when you begin playing with her, but she does not become overly repetitive.

- Compare to the previous version (Dance Star Mickey, Rockstar Mickey, and Master Moves Mickey) - Cheerin' Minnie falls in the middle. She is definitely better than Rockstar Mickey... but maybe not quite as cool as Master Moves Mickey

- Sounds a bit mechanical whenever she moves - not a big deal.

- A bit of warning - each year my daughter receives a dancing Mickey - and each year she loves it... for about two weeks. After she has head all of the songs and seen all of the moves she gets a bit bored with it. We hope that Cheerin' Minnie has a little more staying power since our daughter (she is 4) is going through a cheerleader phase.

- Batteries are included

Final Verdict - While your child may become bored with it after a few weeks the Cheerin' Minnie Mouse will likely be an immediate hit with your child. While it lacks some of the flash of Dance Star Mickey or last year's Master Moves Mickey - it still has plenty of moves. 

4 stars

Final Verdict - The Doc is In Clinic is bright, colorful, and fun for children. It is a little heavy on plastic, but it seems to beholding up. It should be a big hit for any fan of Disney Junior's Doc McStuffins

Sofia the First is one of the most popular shows on Disney Junior. Sofia and her friends Clover, Mia, and her family (Amber and James) learn about being royalty and importance of being kind. We have used several of the Sofia the First story lines as life lessons for our 4 year old daughter.... things like inviting everyone to birthday parties and why it is important to always be kind. Therefore, my wife and I really don't mind our daughter watching Sofia the first (or really... any of the Disney Junior shows like Jake and the Never Land Pirates and Doc McStuffins)

The Mattel line of Sofia the First toys received criticism when they were first released. Fortunately, they have made a number of improvements to many of the toys, and while they are still far from perfect they are now at least *acceptable* in terms of build quality. The Sofia the First Royal Family gift set was improved - initially all of the dolls heads popped off - very easily. In this updated set (purchased in September 2013) the heads remain firmly attached to the royal family members!

Notes

- Comes with Sofia the First, Amber, James, Queen Miranda, and King Roland.

- Not sure why they designed it this way, but it is difficult to make King Roland, James, and Amber to stand on their own - even on hard surfaces.

- Sofia the First and Amber speak when used when used with the base of the Sofia the First Magical Talking Castle. King Roland and James interact with the castle but only play music.... Queen Miranda does not interact with the castle.

- As mentioned, Mattel has improved the dolls and the heads no longer pop off.

Final Verdict - While the Sofia the First Royal Family has been improved it still could use a better design. I am not sure why Mattel designed the set where it is difficult for most of the family to stand on their own. It would also be nice if all of the members worked with the Sofia the First Magical Talking Castle (instead of just Sofia and Amber)

3 1/2 Stars​​​.

XcrB7P4iNSA.description:
The Doc McStuffins Check Up Center is a fun way for our child to pretend to be a fellow toy doctor. The Center has everything you will need - all of the proper toy medical tools, x-ray centers, and their very own Big Book of Boo Boos. While I would have preferred that it be made of thicker plastic (or even *gasp* wood) it is still a very cool toy for Doc McStuffins fan.

Notes

- Come with a large variety of Doc McStuffins features - an Otoscope, Reflex Hammer, and a syringe

- Pushing the center of the Check-up center causes it to become interactive. Ideally you place you place Lambie in the middle so that Doc can run through her diagnosis.

- Has a X-ray machine with two plates - one showing Lambie with a broken heart and the other shows her with butterflies in her belly.

- Turning the Big Book of Boo Boos causes Doc McStuffins to explain the illness and the diagnosis.

- The Check Up Center looks just like the one in the show

- Has a storage center with doors inside the cabin

- Assembly takes about 30 minutes

- Our unit came with one incorrect piece - one of the side shelves did not fit

- The construction is 100% plastic - which makes it very light but I worry about the overall durability of the set.

- It doesn't take up as much space as it would appear - you need about a 12" by 24" space for it to fit.

Final Verdict - This could be the ideal play set for the Doc McStuffins fan. All of the pieces work well and it is pretty well designed. Overall, it is one of the better toys that I have reviewed in 2013. 

4 1/2 Stars

We are The Engineering Family, a family of educators working to show you how to make learning fun and engaging through toy unboxings, toy reviews, and original series designed to give insight into imaginative play within your family. With Mr. Engineer as an experienced engineer with a love of exploring new things, Mrs. Engineer an award-winning teacher with a math and counseling focus, and their daughter The Assistant you can think of The Engineering channel as your imagination station. A Disney Junior Toy Review by The_Engineering_Family. Disney Junior's Jake and the Never Land Pirates is one of the most popular shows for both boys and girls under the age of 7. Jake and his pirate crew perform good deeds whiel often foiling the plans of the verbally challenged Captain Hook. Our 4 year old  daughter loves the show  As parents we appreciate that the show never has a cringe worthy moment (no inappropriate words for preschoolers) and that it promotes friendship and teamwork.

The Jake and the Never Land Pirates Treasure Hunt Laptop allows your child to learn along with Jake. While the games (and more notably the screen) are not near the quality level of a Leap Pad or an actual Laptop it is still a fun (and relatively inexpensive) way for them to play learning games with Jake and his crew.

Notes-

- Has multiple modes and games - shapes, numbers, and other games.

- Has a small touchscreen that can be used with the attached mouse pad. The action key on the mouse are used for movement and selecting options - but note that moving the mouse does NOT move the cursor on the screen (unlike a real computer mouse).

- Jake's voice on the Treasure Hunt Laptop doesn't sound exactly like the show - it is very close, but (to my wife's ear at least) it is different

- Most of the games involves tracing shapes, number, and letters  - the games are inspired  by Jake and his crew.

- The touchscreen is not backlit which makes it difficult to use in low light settings

- Batteries are included

- Parents may want to learn a little bit how the Treasure Hunt Laptop works prior to letting your child using it - it is not difficult but it may save a bit of frustration.

Final Verdict - The Jake and the Never Land Pirates Treasure Hunt Learning Laptop would probably be served better by having a larger screen, but it is still fun and educational for children. It also has the seal of approval from my teacher wife for it's educational value.

4 Stars

I am a fan of the Nyrius Aries Prime - it allows me to wirelessly transmit an H signal from my computer, cable box, and even my iPad to my HD television. The wirelss connection allows you to eliminate and/or add new devices to your home media center. You can see in the video that I am using it with my iPad to mirror my iPad's screen on to my television. The primary purpose is to mirror your laptop's screen to your television, but you will be able to find other uses too.

Notes

- Comes with a HD Transmitter which is slightly larger than a standard USB flash drive. The tranmistter does require power - either through the included AC adapter or a USB-to-mini USB connector (which allows both your laptop or an external battery pack to provide power).

- The HD receiver is about the size of two decks of cards and can be mounted to a wall behind your television. It does require power and comes with a second ac power adapter.

- Also comes with an L-shaped HDMI connector and a HDMI cable

- Supports full HD at 1080P and 3D playback

- I have not noticed any type of latency - except when the unit got hot (Which was being provided by an external source) . Make sure that you do not place the Nyrius receiver on a heat source (like a cable box or anything else that gets hot).

- The transmitter and receivers paired almost instantly - and I was able to go from the box to a complete set-up in 5-10 minutes.

- In the video you can see how I was able to use the Aries Prime with my iPad (although it does require some additional accessories - such as a 30pin-to-HDMI connector).

Final Verdict - The ability to wireless transmit and receive wirelss HD signals offers you a lot of flexibility in your home media devices. The Nyrius Aries Prime allows you to plugin a transmitter into the HDMI port of laptop and immediately begin to stream a wireless HD signal. It is easy to set-up and works very well so it is an easy recommendation.

5 Stars

The PlaySkool Showcam 2 in 1 digital camera and projector is my pick to be the most popular gift for Christmas 2013. It is part toy - but it is still a fully functioning camera and projector. While there are a couple of areas for improvement (a bit brighter projector and a higher resolution picture) it is still to be a huge hit with your kids.

Notes -

- Works as a camera - the image quality is similar to circa 2004 camera phones, but it is good enough. Files come in at about 100k, and the low light performance is somewhat lacking. However, your child will never know.

- The pictures can be transferred to your computer using a mini-USB cable - for some reason the cable is not included.

- A flip of the switch turns the camera into a LED projector. Very simple to use and navigate through your pictures - ideally, I would have preferred if the projector was about 25% brighter. Also, the focus of the pictures can be adjusted by turning the camera lens.

- Requires 4 AA batteries.

- In addition to the projector the camera also has a 2" by 2" LCD viewing screen.

- Includes special modes (as you can see in the video) that let's you take pictures as a soccer player, super hero, pirate, various animals and other funny scenes. Many of these special modes are automatically animated and generate sounds.

- Easy to operate - our four year daughter was able to take pictures within a couple minutes. Using the LCD view finder for framing her photos - most of her shots turned out much better than expected.

- Does not feature a flash.


Final Verdict - The PlaySkol Show Cam is probably the top toy that I reviewed in 2013. While I would have preferred if the pictures were a little bit higher resolution - it is still an awesome gift for young (under age 7) children. Buy it early because this is likely to be one of the toys for Christmas 2013. Recommended

5 Stars

go_vWzptWEU.description:
The world of exterior (and interior) lighting has really changed over the last 10 years. For nearly 100 years your only choice was incandescent lights - you could choose between halogen or standard. Then came fluorescent lights, but they weren't great for floodlight since they were sensitive to temperature and you had limited color options. Now with the rapid emergence of LED lights you can have it all - the low operating costs of fluorescent lights - the instant on of a incandescent - and the new ability to change colors.

The HitLight 10W Color Changing Floodlight is an awesome combination of value (it is inexpensive for a LED), a remote control for changing colors, and it is very bright. We are still exploring all of the uses for this LED floodlight - as an accent light for our interior - for my wife's classroom (she is a teacher) - for my daughter's bedroom - or as specialty light for Christmas and Halloween.

Notes

- 10 watts is rated as a 40Watt equivalent, but it seems much brighter than that

- Color changing - has the ability to change between 16 different colors - including three different light modes.

- Waterproof

- Plugs directly into a standard wall outlet

Final Verdict - I am a fan of the HitLights 10Watt color changing LED light. It offers a bright color LED at a very reasonable price point. You may be surprised at all of the places you can use this LED light. Recommended.

4 1/2 Stars

Some of the coolest Play Doh toys are ones that mix together separate colors of Play Doh to make either new colors (Like the Elmo color mixer or rainbow designs (like this set) and the Ice Cream Perfect Twist ) . 

The Play Doh Sweet Cafe Swirling Shake Shoppe set is one of my daughter's favorites. It allows you to mix together a variety of colors to make very real looking shakes and smoothies. It is a bit of an advanced playset so children under the age of 5 will likely need a little help (especially in fastening down the crank for the shake maker).

- Includes a small syringe/extruder for making frosting

- Also includes a small stamp/press for making fruits such as strawberries and bananas.

- The crank can be a difficult to fasten down and to turn - younger children may struggle a bit.

FInal Verdict - A fun playset, but one that will cause you to use lots of Play Doh. The playset isn't too difficult to clean, but it may be a little advanced for children under the age of 5

Doc McStuffins is one of the most popular shows on Disney Jr. It features a young doctor who cares for and fixes all of toys in her neighborhood. Stuffy the Dragon is one of Doc's patients and friends - and he has now his own Check Up play set. In truth, it is very similar to the Doc McStuffin's Check up kit... but it is more geared towards boys. Fortunately, for us, our daughter's favorite color is blue and she was thrilled to have an all blue doctor kit!

Both playsets are similar except in color (Doc's bag is pink with purple while Stuffy the Dragon's is blue trimmed in yellow). The only other difference is that Doc's Check Up bag comes with a thermometer (although it doesn't look much like a thermometer).

- Comes with an Otoscope, blood pressure cuff, sound effects stethoscope, stickers, syringe, and a doctors bag.

- The stethoscope plays sounds from Stuffy and the Doc McStuffins show.

- The doctor's bag isn't as effective in holding all of Stuffy's doctor gear as the Doc McStuffins Doctor bag

- Another difference from the Doc McStuffins Doctor bag is that a thermometer is not included (which seems an odd).

Jake and the Never Land Pirates is a show that is popular for both boys, and somewhat surprisingly, girls. My daughter and her friends often run around pretending to be Izzy in pursuit for gold doubloons.

- A trap door is located underneath the ships wheel

- A water cannon can be positioned around the ship - two shots are included

- When the Jolly Roger rolls across the floor it has a wobble that is designed to look like it sailing across the seas.

Notes on the Sailwagon

- Comes with Jake, Izzy, and Cubby - and all three look exactly as they do in the show. One very minor complaint is that while Izzy has her pixie dust (around neck) Jake does not have his wooden sword and Cubby does not have his map.

- The water cannon can be placed in several spots on the Sailwagon - and has three shots included

- The sailwagon rolls easily across any surface - although the steering wheel does not turn the wheels (not that I was expecting it to)

- Jake and Cubby can stand on their own but it is a bit difficult to get Izzy to stand.

- The sail on the sailwagon turns easily

- The quality is what you would expect.... it is plastic but it feels pretty solid.

Our family is a fan of the Play Doh Picnic Bucket. It has all of the necessary accessories required to make a picnic lunch full of sandwiches, fruits, and snacks. - Clean up is pretty easy - there are not many small crevices for the Play Doh to get stuck in.

- One of the best parts - everything that comes with the playset will fit int he storage bucket!

Final verdict - The Play Doh Picnic Bucket is a fun and easy playset - there are more elaborate Play Doh sets available (like the Drill N Fill or the Play Doh Disney Prettiest Princess), but this one can be set-up and cleaned-up in less than 15 minutes/

vJajUcUsaWw.description:
The SanDisk Connect Media Drive allows you to significantly expand the memory of your tablet. The SanDisk Connect solves that problem by setting up a local network that allows you to steam files (and media) into special SanDisk device. It allows 8 people to share files and up to 5 to stream videos.

The SanDisk Connect has a few areas for improvement (especially in the app) but for the most part it does exactly what it states. I am thrilled that it gives me the ability to double the memory of my iPad and share files to others.

Notes-

- The SanDisk device sets up as a wireless router (without a connection to the internet) - so you will need to go to your setting and connect to the "SanDisk" network.

- You will need to download the SanDisk app - the app is works ok but it isn't anything fancy in terms of file creation or search options

- Expandable and can except 64G SD memory cards so that you can have a total of 128G of memory. This means that your 64G iPad can be expanded up to 192G

- Transfer files is the biggest oddity about the device - You can easily transfer files from your iPad/iPhone/Device to SanDisk Drive and vice versa. However.... (at the time of this review) you can not transfer from a SD card directly to the SanDisk Drive - you must first transfer it to your iPad/iPhone/Device and then transfer it from your iPad/iPhone/Device to the SanDisk. It is puzzling that you can not transfer directly from the SD Memory card to the SanDisk.

- Transfer speeds are more than acceptable.

- I never experienced delays when streaming videos

- Rechargeable - the manufacturer claims that you can stream for up to 8 hours on one charge

- Can be password protected

- Small and lightweight - about 60% the size of a deck of cards

- Perfect for long car rides when everyone wants to stream their own movie to their device

- Another use is in business meetings for sharing files, documents, purchase orders to multiple people. Save the files as PDF file and put it on a SD memory card and then everyone will have access to the files on their own personal tablet.

Final Verdict - The SanDisk Connect Media Drive is a great way to stream files across multiple devices. The SanDisk App has room for improvement, and I am puzzled as to why you have to download files from the external memory to your ipad/iphone/other device before you can save it directly to the SanDisk integrated drive (hopefully this will be fixed with an app upgrade). However, the Media Drive is a very good option for sharing to multiple devices. Recommended

4 Stars

Please Subscribe Here http://www.youtube.com/user/TheEngineeringFamily?sub_confirmation=1

Our daughter has always loved Mickey Mouse Clubhouse - almost from the time she was born (she is nearly 4). The Mickey Mouse Fly N Slide Clubhouse allows our daughter to play out some of the scenes from the show. While the Fly N Slide Clubhouse will entertain younger children older children may find it a little too basic.

Notes-

- Comes with a Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse figures - both bend at the waist so that they can sit down in the airplane, chair, and teeter totter.

- The airplane caught my daughter's attention, but it is tough to keep Mickey or Minnie in the plane without falling out.

- Comes with a teeter totter and a table and chair set.

- The top of the clubhouse features a trap door (that is activated by pushing down on the telescope) causing Mickey or Minnie to drop down and slide down the slide.

- The slide is a little like the plane - it is fun at first but our daughter quickly lost interest.

- Does not require batteries and does not make any sounds (which is a nice thing)

- The inside of the Clubhouse does not feature any working components. It would have been great if it looked a little more like the Clubhouse on the show.

Final Verdict - The Mickey Mouse Fly N Slide will bring smiles to all of the fans of Mickey Mouse Clubhouse. Older kids may get bored with it pretty quickly but younger kids (under three) will love playing with Mickey and Minnie.

3 1/2 Stars

If you have never seen them, the Fisher Price Little People Klip Klop toys are some of the coolest new toys to hit the market. They are a combination of old school toys with new characters from both Disney and Nickelodeon. I will admit that our (nearly) 4 year old daughter prefers the Little People Disney Princess Klip Klop Stable over the Mike the Knight Arena... and not just because she is a girl. 

The Princess Stable features a series of ramps and (you guessed it) stables for the Disney Princesses and their horse to hang out. The Stables also features a Castle region where the princesses and their horses can dance to music and even march down the Castle's ramp. Our family's opinion is that the Princess Stables is one of the best toys available for children under 4.

Mike the Knight Arena - The arena features a ramp that Mike the Knight can Klip Klop into a jousting arean where he knocks down the targets. Mike and his horse Galahad Klip Klop down portions and then charge down others - making it a faster toy than the Princess Stable. However, Mike can get a little unstable (and unlike the Princess Stable) and tip over. While it is a cool toy it is a bit of a one trick pony (no pun intended) and does not feature all of the additional areas of play like the Princess Stables/

Which is better? Well it depends on if you are a bigger fan of Mike the Knight or Disney Princesses - but this dad thinks that the Princess Stables offers more activities and provides more areas for imaginative play!

I have reviewed several different power banks over the year, but none of them had a built in solar panel. The solar chargin option is attractive for when I am camping, hiking or even on a boat. Having the option to use a conventional 5V mini USB or sunlight is an attractive feature... but remember even in direct sunlight it would take many hours to fully charge a 7200mAh power bank. Due to the time it would take to fully charge many people use the solar panel to help augment the output of the battery... meaning that when you are charging your smartphone/table/device you can use the sunlight to help assist the internal battery.

Notes

- The max input from the monocrystalline solar panel is 5V at 180mA ... while I have not done the math it does mean that it will take over 24 hours (of sun light) for the powerbank to fully charge.

- It can be charged even on a cloudy day, but it will not charge under a normal household light

- The PowerADD has one 5V 1A output which can charge smarphones to tablets

- Comes with 4 charging tips - a 30 pin tip for Apple products, a PSP (or so I am assuming) tip, and both micro and min USB tips (The mini USB tip is also used for charging the PowerADD through a convention USB power source).

- Provides 7200mAh of capacity - which is enough to charge and iPhone 3 times and provide about a 90% charge to an iPad 2

- Does not come with a carrying case

- The solar panel does make it a little larger than a comparable 7200mAh external battery pack - but in my opinion it is an acceptable compromise

- You must hold the power button for 3 full seconds in order to turn the unit on and off (I mention it...because at first I struggled trying to turn it on).

Final verdict - While business travelers may prefer smaller non-solar options in their powerbanks it is easy to see why people who like the outdoors would choose the PowerADD 7200mAh Powerbank. Just remember that even in full sunlight it will charge the powerbank at about 1/5th the speed of a 5V 1A power source.

4 1/2 Stars

Jake and the Neverland Pirates is one of the most popular shows on the Disney Channel. 

 The Disney Lego Duplo Jake and the Neverland Pirates sets are a fun way to creatively act out and pretend to be a part of jake and his crew. The two sets that I am reviewing/comparing are Jake's Ship Bucky and the Neverland Hideout.

Jake's Ship Bucky - Comes with Jake, Captain Hook, Bucky and a block that has a picture of Skully. Kids of all skill levels will be able to assemble Bucky, but Pirate Island may be a bit more challenging. Another fun feature is that Bucky's water cannon actually fires. 

Neverland Hideout - Comes with Izzy and Cubby. There are lots of options for creating different types of Neverland Hideout. However, the picture on the box will challenge any child under four years old. A fun feature of the Neverland Hideout is the there are two pieces that rotate. This will allow you to create rotating bridge, trees, or even rotate Cuuby and Izzy!

Final Verdict - If you are only going to buy one playset I would recommend Jake's Ship Bucky, but really if you planning to invest into the Jake's Lego Duplos your best option is to buy both.

Please Subscribe Here http://www.youtube.com/user/TheEngineeringFamily?sub_confirmation=1

My daughter is nearly 4 years old and "Jake and the Neverland Pirates" is one of her favorite shows. Jake is consistently one of her favorites and the only one that she tries to act out. Her friends all rotate pretending to be Izzy (they are girls... so that wouldn't dream of being Jake!) and they chase after Captain Hook's treasure. I digress.

The Lego Duplo set is fun for our daughter because it allows her to build and act out imaginary scenes from Jake. The Neverland Hideout is a fun playset, but it is more difficult to assemble than the Jake's ship Bucky. The nice thing is that it can be put together in a variety of of configurations/

If you combine the Neverland Hideout with Jake's Hip Bucky your child will have all of the main characters from the show and has enough blocks to create a variety of scenes.

Notes

- Comes with Izzy and Cubby and both characters look like they do on the cartoon.

- It is unlikely that children under four can make the hideout look like it does on the box cover, but really there is no wrong way to put together the hideout.

- One gold doubloon is included

- Has a fun slide for the characters to go down.

- Comes with two rotating blocks. This allows for rotating trees, bridges, or even the crows nest!

- If you are trying to decide between Jake'S Ship Bucky or the Neverland Hideout Playset - I would recommend Bucky since it includes Jake, Hook, and Bucky.

Final Verdict - Fans of the Disney Junior show "Jake and the Neverland Pirates" or fans of Lego Duplo will be thrilled with this playset. You may want to consider adding the Lego Duplo jake's Pirate Ship Bucky set as well. Recommended

4 1/2 Stars

My daughter is nearly 4 years old and "Jake and the Neverland Pirates" is one of her favorite shows.  Jake is consistently one of her favorites and the only one that she tries to act out. Her friends all rotate pretending to be Izzy (they are girls... so that wouldn't dream of being Jake!) and they chase after Captain Hook's treasure. I digress.

The Lego Duplo set is fun for our daughter because it allows her to build and act out imaginary scenes from Jake. The Pirate Ship Bucky is pretty easy to assemble and has a water canon that is easy to load and fire. The Pirate Island has numerous configurations and may require the help of a parent in order to get it to look like the picture.

If you combine the Jake's Ship Bucky with the other Lego Duplo Playset - The Neverland Hideout your child will have all of the main characters from the show and has enough blocks to create a variety of scenes.

Notes

- Comes with Jake and Captain Hook. Skully is included but he it painted onto a block. The good news is that Jake and Captain Hook look like they do on the cartoon.

- Bucky is pretty simple to put together a parent may need to help in the beginning but most children 3 and up will be able to do it with minimal frustration.

- Pirate Island is a little more difficult - there are many configurations but to get it to look like the box a parent or older sibling may need to help out.

- A treasure chest and one gold doubloon is included

- The water canon fires shots several feet through the air - two shots are included.

- If you are trying to decide between Jake'S Ship Bucky or the Neverland Hideout Playset - I would recommend Bucky since it includes Jake, Hook, and Bucky.

Final Verdict - Fans of the Disney Junior show "Jake and the Neverland Pirates" or fans of Lego Duplo will be thrilled with this playset. You may want to consider adding the Lego Duplo Neverland Hideout set as well. Recommended

We love Princess Ariel from Disney's "The Little Mermaid"! See all of our Surprise videos   http://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLoLQ9unpi4OEEM3rUVjLGa0pUaXQvW3Wd

Please Subscribe Here http://www.youtube.com/user/TheEngineeringFamily?sub_confirmation=1

If you have a little girl (or possibly a little boy) you already know that Ariel is one of the most popular Disney Princesses. Our daughter's (who is 4) favorite disney princess is Belle - followed by Cinderella, Merida, Rapunzel, and Ariel (and she will list them in that order!I)The Disney Princess Ariel's Royal Ship Playset is part ship and part Ariel Grotto. In many ways it reminds us of a Disney Castle playset.... but one that also serves as a boat!

Our daughter really enjoys the Royal Ship. She likes how Ariel (and Eric) can stand at the mast and turn the wheel. However, she prefers turning the playset into Ariel's grotto. There she sets up the bed, plays with the mirror and vanity, has Ariel go down the slide, and pretends to fee her dinner.

Notes-

- This playset does NOT come with any dolls... Ariel and Eric are sold separately

- The Royal Ship transforms into Ariel's grotto and come fully equipped with a bed, water slide, table, vanity (with picture/mirror) and dinner.

- Some very small parts are included, so I would not recommend for children under 3

- Comes with a very small Sebastian.

- Not to be used in water - the Royal Ship will not float in water

- Assembly is not hard, but the directions are not very clear. 

- This product was provided for an unbiased review

Budget about 10-15 for full assembly

Final Verdict - The Disney Princess Ariel's Royal Ship Playset may be the perfect gift for any fan of the Little Mermaid. We would prefer if it can with at least one doll, but other than that it will likely bring big smiles.

4 1/2 Stars

Playskool makes some of our favorite toys! See all of our Surprise videos   http://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLoLQ9unpi4OEEM3rUVjLGa0pUaXQvW3Wd

Please Subscribe Here http://www.youtube.com/user/TheEngineeringFamily?sub_confirmation=1

The PlaySkool Poppin' Park Popn' Pick Up Elefun Toy combines the Elefun and a new take on the old push popcorn popper. Playskool also produces the popular PlaySkool Park Elefun Busy Ball Popper, which is fun but a little loud. The Pick Up toy has a couple of advantages it helps to encourage your child to walk (and chase the balls) and it is much quieter than the Busy Ball Poppers.

Notes-

- Your child pushed the toy and has balls pop out of the Elefun's trunk. The Elefun can then suck up the balls as you roll over them!

- This is one of the rare toys that works better on carpet than on wood floors. On hardwood floors the balls roll everywhere (like... under furniture)

- Toddlers (even preschoolers) may have a tough time picking up the balls with the toy - the combination of a small opening and rolling bars makes it more difficult than you would think.

- Does not require batteries - so it is relatively quiet. This is a nice contrast to the Playskool Busy Ball Poppers which can be pretty loud!

- Comes with 5 balls and three can be stored in the handle

- Designed for children ages 18 and up - but children over 3 years may get bored.

- Some minor assembly is required - does require a philips head screwdriver

Final Verdict - A fun and (relatively) quiet toy for toddler. They may become a little frustrated in trying to pick up the balls, but this is one toy that you can purchase for a child without getting an angry eye from a parent.

4 Stars

"Three Little Pigs" has been popular for generations. Play Doh combines three little cans of Play Doh with the Three Little Pigs and the Big Bad Wolf so that kids (probably best for preschoolers) can use imaginative play to act out the tale.

As a note - this is a minor Play Doh playset - there are a limited number of molds and capability to the Playset. While it is fun don't expect something like the Play Doh Drill N Fill Playset or the Play Doh Puppies Playset.

- The Big Bad Wolf is a hard plastic figurine... although the is attached to a chimney to the Big Bad Wolf - we would have preferred that he was stand alone.

Final Verdict - The Play Doh Three Little Playset is a fun way for a preschooler to turn one of their favorite fairy tales into imaginative Play Doh fun. Unfortunately, a better mold for the Three Little Pigs would have really helped make the playset even better.

duRa0jKDUoM.description:
I have been using Jabra bluetooth headsets for several years. The first one that I used, the Jabra Clipper, is still among my favorite bluetooth devices. It had/has a minor design flaw (it is hard to actually *clip* it to anything), but it is a great product. The Jabra Play takes all of the features of the Jabra Clipper and (mostly) improves upon them.

  The Jabra Play is a nice combination of bluetooth ease, sound performance, and hands free calling. My biggest complaint (and the reason for 4 stars instead of 5) is that the cable on the earbuds is too short.

Notes-

Bluetooth Unit

- Easy to pair with bluetooth devices

- Works as hand free calling device

- Charge lasts several hours

- Has volume controls on the unit - including the ability to play/pause and to answer calls.

- You can use with any earbuds or headphones

- The clip is not very firm and becomes loose pretty easily. This is not much of a negative, because the alternative to the clip coming loose is that the earbuds would fall out of your ears.

Included Earbuds

- Unlike the Jabra Clipper the earbuds that come standard with the Jabra sound pretty good. While I have heard better sounding earbuds - they are pretty good.

- The earbuds are very comfortable - they feel very soft in your ear, which allows (me) to wear them for extended periods without worrying about them hurting.

- They do a pretty good of noise isolation. I was able to listen to my favorite sports call in show (with ease) while on a riding lawn mower.

- As mentioned the cable on the earbuds is too short - I wish it was 3"-6" longer. When I clip the Jabra Sport to my belt loop the cable on the earbuds becomes taught - eventually causing the Bluetooth Unit to come loose.

Final Verdict- The Jabra Play is a easy to use bluetooth hands free device. I wish that the earbud cables was a little longer, but other than that it is a very solid device.

4 Stars

S-0kV1FnhoA.description:
Lately, I have had the opportunity to evaluate several external power banks. I have also reviewed several small wireless N routers that can be used for travel. However, I have never reviewed a product quite like the EASYACC Wi-Stor. It combines a beefy power bank (8800mAh), with a router, AND it has the capability for file sharing across platforms...including iPhones and iPads.

 That is not to say that the EASYACC Wi-Stor has completely unlimited capabilities. In a perfect world you could store dozens of movies, thousands of songs, and millions of pictures on an external drive that you could stream to your iPad. While it will work for pictures I have not been able to stream in other types of media to my iPad. This may limit your movie watching ability, but it still is a powerful tool -especially for business. This is a device that will allow you to arrange all of your PDF and Word files onto a disc that can be accessed remotely but multiple parties. POs, invoices, and other documents can be easily filed and pulled up when needed.

Notes -

 - Features a 8800mAh power bank. This is enough capacity to fully charge an iPad 2 or charge an iPhone 3-4times. It also gives the EASYACC Wi-stor the ability to work as a file server and router without the need of an external power supply. Make sure that you push (and hold) the power button for 3 seconds before trying to charge any device.

- Wireless A/G/N supported router. Having a small wireless router is helpful when you travel. You never know when you are going to come across a hotel room that only has free LAN through ethernet cables. With a small router you can broadcast your own wireless signal. Also, the fact that it can be run off of the power bank means that you can use it as a router in the event of a power outages.

- The file sharing requires a SD card, external hard drive, or USB jump drive none-of-which are included.

- File sharing is not quite perfect - it works great for pdf, word, and jpg - but I have not been able to transfer a movie from an SD card back to my iPad. Also, I have been unable to transfer anything from my iPad back to the SD card on the EASYACC. I am attributing this mostly to the restrictiveness of Apple and less as a deficiency on the part of EASYACC.

- Remember to change the security settings - if you re going to store PO's and invoices using the default username and password will likely leave your files vulnerable.

- Requires that you download the free version of FTPManager - the app is a bit clumsy, and the directions for setting up the router through FTPManager are not exactly correct, but a little common sense will walk you through the set-up

- Charges through a 5V 1A USB port - I wish that you had the option to plug it into a 110V wall outlet, but I guess this allows it to more of a global device.

- Size - it is a bit on the heavy side and it is about 30% larger than a deck of cards, in fact it is roughly the size of an iPhone, but weighs about 20% more

- Does not come with a case.

Final Verdict- The EASYACC Wi-Stor is one of the better tablet accessories available to businessmen/women. It allows colleagues to wirelessly share files across platforms. This allows PO's or other sales related documents to be available, with near limitless capacity. You will need to work through your security settings, but the EASYACC Wi-stor is a great blend of file sharing, portable router, and file server. Recommended

4 1/2 Stars

Mike the Knight is a relatively new show on Nickelodeon. Mike is a 10 year old knight who is in search for adventure. The Mike the Knight Glendragon Playset features many fun tricks and sounds that is sure to bring smiles to a child's face. It features zip line, trap doors, catapults, and disappearing treasures - so much that I enjoyed playing with it (almost) as much as my 3 year old daughter. As you would expect other accessories are for sale - such as Mike's 8 year old sister Evie.

Notes-

 - Features a two figures - Mike the Knight and his horse Galahad. Just like in the show Mike has a very large head, which is cute, but it makes it difficult for him to stand on carpet.

- Includes a treasure chest that can automatically hide a golden treasure. 

- A catapult fits on top of the castle and can fire a large rock - the directions in the box state that you want to make sure that you don't fire the rock towards a person's eye!

- Mike's bed lifts up to feature an escape slide - although it the escape hatch seems a little too small which makes it a little tough for Mike to escape.

- The top of the castle turret rotates so that Mike enter or leave the castle

- A push of the button causes the castle to play Mike the Knight sounds to play

- Mike can hold onto a zip line and zip from his flag pole to a position outside of the castle

- Mike fits on Galahad, but it is not a very tight fit and he can easily fall off. Not that big of a deal, but it may frustrate some children.

- Galahad's food trough can double as a bench

- Very little assembly required.


Final Verdict-The Mike the Knight Glendragon Playset is fun for both fans and non-fans of Mike the Knight. While the playset has a few minor shortcomings it is still has plenty of tricks, secret passages, and fun to keep most kids all smiles.

4 Stars

In 2012 Fisher Price introduced the Fisher Price Little People Disney Princess Songs Palace which has been a huge hit with toddlers. Now in 2013 Fisher Price has introduced the Little People Klip Klop Princess Stables, which combines Disney princesses with their favorite horses. The question is - which one is for you and your family?

The Fisher Price Little People Klip Klop Princess Stables comes with both Princess Aurora (from Sleeping Beauty) and Rapunzel (for the Disney movie Tangled) each on their horse - other princess are available (Belle, Cinderella, and Ariel). The Princess stable includes a series of ramps that the princesses are able to Klip Klop down. The Princess Stable also includes a rotating table that plays music and a front ramp that plays authentic sounding horse sounds!

The Fisher Price Little People Disney Princess Song Palace does not have the Klip Klop sounds of the Princess Stables, but it does offer more a princess castle setting. The Song Palace features a dance table that plays music, and a spot where each princess is recognized and speaks (or sings) in their real voice. In short, the Song Palace is more of an interactive doll house - and our 3 year old daughter really likes it!

So which playset is the right one for your family? Well if your Disney Princess fan enjoys horses you really should consider the Princess Stables - but if you are looking more for a doll house/castle you may want to consider the Song Palace!

Our 3 year old daughter has had the Little People Disney Princess Castle for nearly a year, an it is still one of her favorite toys. It is cute, fun, full of Disney Princesses, and interactive and has helped keep her attention for 10 to 15 minutes at a time. The Little People Disney Princess Klip Klop Princess Stables has already passed the castle in her eyes... because it matches her favorite Disney princesses with HORSES, better yet, as the horses strut down the ramp they make a klip klop sound that really sounds like a horse!

Notes

- The horses make a Klip Klop sound as the go down each of the ramps

- The ramps are not connected, which is a bit unfortunate since it would be nice if the princess and horse could start at the top and Klip Klop all the way donw to the bottom

- The horses can be placed on the small turntable and be spun (while playing music)

- As the horses go down the small ramp leading out of the castle horse sounds plays

- Two volume settings

- Comes with Aurora (Sleeping Beauty) and Rapunzel - but additional princesses can be purchased (Belle, Ariel, and Cinderella)

- The castle and stables feature many pictures of favorite princess firends (Pascal, Mrs. Potts, Chip, and etc)

- It is a bit tricky to get the horses to Klip Klop down the ramps without tipping over - younger children may struggle a bit, but ultimately it will likely help them with their motor skills.

- Requires 3 AA batteries which are not included

- This playset takes up quite a bit of room - it can not be fold or unassembled 

- Assembly takes about 5 minutes - but adding the stickers will require another 5-10 minutes


Final Verdict - While the Little People Disney Princess Castle may have more staying power the Little People Disney Princess Klip Klop Stable offers a fun way to watch your child's favorite princess on a horse! Recommended for any Disney Princess fan!

4 1/2 Stars

The Coast HP314 Long Range 1132 LED Flashlight is a serious source of light. I was ABSOLUTELY shocked at how much brighter the Coast HP314 is compared to my 2 cell LED maglite... it is the difference between looking into the sun versus looking into the moon. The price point for the Coast HP314 is significantly higher than the Maglite, but after watching the video portion of the review you will begin to see why the disparity exists.

The real question is - do you need a flashlight that is this big, that is this bright, and is this solid? If you are in law enforcement the answer is likely "yes" , but it also makes a great flashlight for hunters, or anyone who is looking for dogs/cats/lost pets on a dark night. While it may not be the flashlight you pull out when you are trying to look under your refrigerator it certainly will have its uses.

Notes-

- Three settings - 1132 Lumens - which is significantly brighter than my (what claims to be) 6.5Million candle power spotlight, an alternating strobe light, and a low power 95 Lumen light... which is brighter than my 2 cell LED maglite.

- 4 D batteries are included

- Features a unique pull/push light beam adjuster - this is different than the typical turn-to-adjust beam .

- Comes with a very nice padded case - it reminds me of some of the handgun cases you see on the market

- The battery life at 1132 Lumens is 4 hours and 15 minutes and 95 lumens the battery life is 192 hours

- Water tight, and while I wouldn't use it for scuba diving you won't have to worry about using it in a driving rain

- Comes with a shoulder strap and a belt loop holder - the shoulders strap holder comes in handy since the flashlight can get pretty heavy after extended use.

- The combination of its weight and its solid construction means that the Coast HP314 can be used as club or baton if needed. trust me, for self defense it would offer the same protection as a baseball bat.

Final Verdict - The Coast HP314 1132 Lumen Long Range LED Flashlight is an expensive but powerful flashlight. Not everyone needs a flashlight that can be seen on the moon, but if you do this is the one for you. This a big, heavy, expensive and powerful light but if you need something of this caliber I certainly recommend the Coast 1132 Lumen LED Flashlight. A perfect choice for law enforcement, hunters, firefighters, or anyone who needs to light up large areas. Recommended

5 Stars

The Disney Junior Disney Princess Sofia the First Royal Purse and Gloves dress up set.

Notes-

- The gloves are a bit ill fitting and we had difficulty getting our 3 year old's hand into them. Once they were in they looked a bit awkward since the fingers seemed way too long for the width.

- The purse uses velcro for a clasp - not a problem since it seems to work pretty well.

- The material for both the purse and the gloves feel as bit cheap - it is feels thin, cheap, but rigid.

- The ring that is included is a simple plastic purple ring which is sewn into the glove (but it can be removed)

- The purse is a bit on the smallish size - even on our three year old it clearly looks like a toy.

- Does include a card that can be used for Sofia's Talking Amulet - without the Amulet the card is just a bit of a novelty. I would recommend buying the Sofia the First Talking Amulet in addition (or in the place of) this set - it is one of our daughter's favorite pieces of jewelry.

Final Verdict - Not a bad playset if your child already has a Sofia dress, but as a stand alone it does leave a bit desired. Our biggest disappointment was that the material for both the purse and gloves feels rather cheap... but at this price point I guess we should not have expected too much.
